The '''Balfed family''' was a powerful [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The Balfed family was once influential in galactic society. During the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Balfed family lost their influence and prestige. Their fall from grace was compounded when a rival, the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]], framed and disgraced them. The youngest descendent, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Espan Balfed]], served as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Imperial Customs Frigate|customs frigate]]. He had no money, influence or significance and was considered to be a noble in name only.
